name: 15_beam_envelope
title: Space-charge beam transport (RZ): drift expansion & Brillouin solenoid
notes: The solenoid case uses the paraxial (linear-field, constant beta_z) envelope model; the residual difference comes from the fringe-field non-linearity and rotation-induced axial slowing included in PIC. Envelope equation a'' = K/a - (eB/2 gamma m beta c)^2 a, K = 2I/(I_A beta^3 gamma^3)
